children.heading: 登録の拒否
children.summary_ja: 金融商品取引業の登録拒否事由を定める条文。第三項・第四項は、その拒否事由の判定で使う「持株会社」「子会社」の定義。
children.summary_en: Sets the grounds on which the Prime Minister must refuse to register a Financial Instruments Business Operator. Paragraphs (3) and (4) — the part cited elsewhere — are definitions of "holding company" and "subsidiary" used in applying those grounds.

children.text_ja: 第一項第五号ニの「持株会社」とは、子会社(国内の会社に限る。)の株式又は持分の取得価額(最終の貸借対照表において別に付した価額があるときは、その価額)の合計額の総資産の額(内閣府令で定める方法による資産の合計金額をいう。)から内閣府令で定める資産の額(内閣府令で定めるところにより算出した額をいう。)を除いた額に対する割合が百分の五十を超える会社をいう。
children.text_en: The term "holding company" in paragraph (1), item (v)(d) means a company for which the ratio of (a) the total acquisition cost of the shares or equity interests of its subsidiaries (limited to domestic companies) (or a separately recorded value in the most recent balance sheet, where one exists), to (b) its total assets (as calculated by a method specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance) minus assets specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance, exceeds 50 percent.

clauses_ja.text: 第一項第五号ニの「持株会社」とは、子会社(国内の会社に限る。)の株式又は持分の取得価額(最終の貸借対照表において別に付した価額があるときは、その価額)の合計額の総資産の額(内閣府令で定める方法による資産の合計金額をいう。)から内閣府令で定める資産の額(内閣府令で定めるところにより算出した額をいう。)を除いた額に対する割合が百分の五十を超える会社をいう。

clauses_en.text: The term "holding company" in paragraph (1), item (v)(d) means a company for which the ratio of (a) the total acquisition cost of the shares or equity interests of its subsidiaries (limited to domestic companies) (or a separately recorded value in the most recent balance sheet, where one exists), to (b) its total assets (as calculated by a method specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance) minus assets specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance, exceeds 50 percent.

children.text_ja: 第一項第五号ニ及び前項の「子会社」とは、会社がその総株主等の議決権の過半数を保有する他の会社をいう。この場合において、会社及びその一若しくは二以上の子会社又は当該会社の一若しくは二以上の子会社がその総株主等の議決権の過半数を保有する他の会社は、当該会社の子会社とみなす。
children.text_en: The term "subsidiary" in paragraph (1), item (v)(d) and the preceding paragraph means another company of which a company holds a majority of the Voting Rights of All Shareholders, etc. In this case, another company of which a company and one or more of its subsidiaries, or one or more subsidiaries of that company, hold a majority of the Voting Rights of All Shareholders, etc., is also deemed to be a subsidiary of that company.

clauses_ja.text: 第一項第五号ニ及び前項の「子会社」とは、会社がその総株主等の議決権の過半数を保有する他の会社をいう。
この場合において、会社及びその一若しくは二以上の子会社又は当該会社の一若しくは二以上の子会社がその総株主等の議決権の過半数を保有する他の会社は、当該会社の子会社とみなす。

clauses_en.text: The term "subsidiary" in paragraph (1), item (v)(d) and the preceding paragraph means another company of which a company holds a majority of the Voting Rights of All Shareholders, etc.

In this case, another company of which a company and one or more of its subsidiaries, or one or more subsidiaries of that company, hold a majority of the Voting Rights of All Shareholders, etc., is also deemed to be a subsidiary of that company.

children.heading: 定義
children.summary_ja: 「有価証券」「金融商品取引業」等、この法律の基本用語の定義規定（全体は非常に長大。ここでは他規則から引用されている第八項第六号のみ抜粋）。
children.summary_en: Defines the Act's core terms ("Securities," "Financial Instruments Business," etc.) — an extremely long article overall; only paragraph (8), item (vi), the provision cited elsewhere, is excerpted here.

children.text_ja: この法律において「金融商品取引業」とは、次に掲げる行為(略)のいずれかを業として行うことをいう。
children.text_en: In this Act, "Financial Instruments Business" means conducting, as a business, any of the following acts (abridged here — this paragraph lists ~20 categories of activity; only item (vi) is given in full below, as the one cited elsewhere).

clauses_ja.text: この法律において「金融商品取引業」とは、次に掲げる行為(略)のいずれかを業として行うことをいう。

clauses_en.text: In this Act, "Financial Instruments Business" means conducting, as a business, any of the following acts (abridged here — this paragraph lists ~20 categories of activity; only item (vi) is given in full below, as the one cited elsewhere).

children.text_ja: 有価証券の引受け(有価証券の募集若しくは売出し又は私募若しくは特定投資家向け売付け勧誘等に際し、第六項各号に掲げるもののいずれかを行うことをいう。)
children.text_en: Underwriting of Securities (meaning conducting any of the acts listed in the items of paragraph (6), in connection with a public offering or secondary distribution of securities, or a private placement or solicitation of an offer to sell to professional investors, etc.).

children.heading: （この抜粋では省略）
children.text_en: Items other than (vi) — roughly 20 further categories of financial instruments business (dealing, brokerage, underwriting, investment management, investment advice, crowdfunding intermediation, etc.) — not needed for the citation this excerpt exists to resolve, so not translated here.

children.heading: 自己資本規制比率
children.heading_en: Capital Adequacy Ratio (for Financial Instruments Business Operators)
children.summary_ja: 第一種金融商品取引業者に、資本金等の額を各種リスク相当額で除した「自己資本規制比率」の算出・届出を義務付け、120%を下回らないよう求める条文。
children.summary_en: Requires a Type I Financial Instruments Business Operator to calculate and report a 'Capital Adequacy Ratio' (capital divided by an amount equivalent to various risks), and to keep it at or above 120%.

children.text_ja: 金融商品取引業者は、資本金、準備金その他の内閣府令で定めるものの額の合計額から固定資産その他の内閣府令で定めるものの額の合計額を控除した額の、保有する有価証券の価格の変動その他の理由により発生し得る危険に対応する額として内閣府令で定めるものの合計額に対する比率(以下「自己資本規制比率」という。)を算出し、毎月末及び内閣府令で定める場合に、内閣総理大臣に届け出なければならない。
children.text_en: A Financial Instruments Business Operator shall calculate the ratio (hereinafter referred to as the "Capital Adequacy Ratio") of (a) the total amount of its stated capital, reserves, and other items specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance, minus the total amount of its fixed assets and other items specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance, to (b) the total amount of items specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance as corresponding to risks that may arise from fluctuations in the price of securities it holds and other causes, and shall report it to the Prime Minister as of the end of every month and in cases specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance.

clauses_ja.text: 金融商品取引業者は、資本金、準備金その他の内閣府令で定めるものの額の合計額から固定資産その他の内閣府令で定めるものの額の合計額を控除した額の、保有する有価証券の価格の変動その他の理由により発生し得る危険に対応する額として内閣府令で定めるものの合計額に対する比率(以下「自己資本規制比率」という。)を算出し、毎月末及び内閣府令で定める場合に、内閣総理大臣に届け出なければならない。

clauses_en.text: A Financial Instruments Business Operator shall calculate the ratio (hereinafter referred to as the "Capital Adequacy Ratio") of (a) the total amount of its stated capital, reserves, and other items specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance, minus the total amount of its fixed assets and other items specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance, to (b) the total amount of items specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance as corresponding to risks that may arise from fluctuations in the price of securities it holds and other causes, and shall report it to the Prime Minister as of the end of every month and in cases specified by Cabinet Office Ordinance.

children.text_ja: 金融商品取引業者は、自己資本規制比率が百二十パーセントを下回ることのないようにしなければならない。
children.text_en: A Financial Instruments Business Operator shall ensure that its Capital Adequacy Ratio does not fall below 120 percent.

clauses_ja.text: 金融商品取引業者は、自己資本規制比率が百二十パーセントを下回ることのないようにしなければならない。

clauses_en.text: A Financial Instruments Business Operator shall ensure that its Capital Adequacy Ratio does not fall below 120 percent.

children.text_ja: 金融商品取引業者は、四半期の末日における自己資本規制比率を記載した書面を作成し、当該末日から一月を経過した日から三月間、全ての営業所又は事務所に備え置き、公衆の縦覧に供しなければならない。
children.text_en: A Financial Instruments Business Operator shall prepare a document stating its Capital Adequacy Ratio as of the end of each quarter, and shall keep it available at all of its business offices for public inspection for three months starting one month after that end date.

clauses_ja.text: 金融商品取引業者は、四半期の末日における自己資本規制比率を記載した書面を作成し、当該末日から一月を経過した日から三月間、全ての営業所又は事務所に備え置き、公衆の縦覧に供しなければならない。

clauses_en.text: A Financial Instruments Business Operator shall prepare a document stating its Capital Adequacy Ratio as of the end of each quarter, and shall keep it available at all of its business offices for public inspection for three months starting one month after that end date.
